summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ), a Nasdaq-listed Israeli/Swedish wave-energy developer, furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, carrying its Q3 2026 earnings press release. Results show net loss down roughly 47% year-over-year and operating expenses down 25% for the quarter; nine-month net loss fell 24% with an 80% cut in net financial expenses. The release also flags a Citadel-affiliated beneficial ownership disclosure, a first purchase order from Bharat Petroleum, an AI Digital Twin phase-one completion, and early Port of Los Angeles licensing talks. No transaction terms were disclosed; watch for 13G/13D follow-through and any equity issuance funding the 1 MW Portugal build.
